mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in periods where GDPC1 falls by more than 2% YoY (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of 0.3 percentage points or more signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which pressure corporate margins and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when UNRATE rises by 0.3pp or more (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of 3% or more signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when INDPRO falls by 3% or more over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 3% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of 0.3pp or more AND a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) of 50,000 or more signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when both UNRATE rises by 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls by 50,000 or more in the same month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) of 1% or more signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when GDPC1 falls by 1% or more in a month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of 2% or more signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when INDPRO falls by 2% or more over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
